review.imagery: 36 gallery entries include 14 dated site photographs. All eighteen primary assets, the complete 38-page brochure index, 32 native resources and fourteen September 2026 photographs were visually reviewed. Two repeated primary facade compositions, repeated brochure scenes, textures and generic lifestyle material were excluded. Six brochure scenes add building, roof, gym and home detail. Interiors retain developer-concept scope, including shared Cove design concepts. The full street building supplies the card and hero.
review.floorPlans: All four whole physical pages 2–5 were visually reviewed. Visible category legends identify studio, 1 BR and 2 BR homes. The masked text layer’s stray duplex wording does not override the visible sheet. The official FAQ’s 3 BR duplex claim remains unresolved. No ground/podium sheets or individual saleable areas occur in this packet. The inspected Silver Oak page has no open floor-plan section. Four complete building sheets retain the visible studio, 1 BR and 2 BR legends and exact grouped levels. No individual saleable areas are printed. The current FAQ mentions 3 BR duplexes, which these visible drawings do not identify. Confirm the duplex layouts, standalone contractual sheets and final areas with Imtiaz.
review.location: Whole original brochure map 32 was rendered at 3200 pixels and visually read. Its time rings do not establish individual routes. The four 20–25-minute estimates retain their current official FAQ group scope. The named-place embed supplies no explicit target coordinate pair. Camera-centre values were excluded.
review.provenance: Official project/gallery and September 2026 construction sources retain dated URL and SHA-256 receipts. Original brochures and building drawings retain their actual developer, broker or platform-host attribution. Whole sheets, notices and original source bytes remain intact. Protected researched records remain preserved.
